failure_mode: The execution YAML could be read as connecting all 658 proposition edges before proposition-only attachment review.
correction: Strict components are generated only from 445 response-identity edges; 212 substantive proposition-only edges are classified into four topology cases and never auto-merge strict components.

failure_mode: Status events were attached only to stable candidate identity while immutable revisions carried their own stage.
correction: Status events now require candidate_revision_id; every revision has an independent ordered lifecycle and current-stage view.

failure_mode: A superseded release could not return to PROMOTED although rollback protocol required restoration.
correction: The release state machine and promotion-pointer contract permit transactional SUPERSEDED-to-PROMOTED reactivation after successor rollback evidence.

failure_mode: Candidate and canonical revisions could reference signatures that were only allowed to belong to imported lineages or segments.
correction: Signature subjects now include candidate revisions and canonical-family revisions.

failure_mode: Component IDs depended on connectivity facts but SQL contained no component-edge relation.
correction: p3_component_connectivity_edge and its schema preserve every generating pair fact.

failure_mode: One collision column could not represent multiple collision scopes and no closure-obligation links existed.
correction: Many-to-many collision and closure junctions preserve the full typed multigraph.

failure_mode: Split, hierarchy, variant, and blocked decisions could be stored without their required normalized evidence rows.
correction: Status-specific validation requires the corresponding child structures.

failure_mode: Split/merge/supersede/deprecate cardinalities existed only in prose or JSON.
correction: Database validation enforces relation-specific predecessor/successor cardinalities and disjoint roles.

failure_mode: Candidate and canonical references were optional regardless of disposition.
correction: Status-specific JSON and SQL checks require exactly the appropriate reference.

failure_mode: No-loss claims could not be reconstructed from lineage to 18,276 implementations.
correction: Imported lineage membership is persisted and P3 segments must be nonempty subsets.

failure_mode: P2 lineage-level pair facts lacked an explicit applicability rule after segmentation.
correction: Every endpoint receives a governed resolution status and resolved subject set or fail-closed block.

failure_mode: The verifier depended on deprecated RefResolver behavior.
correction: The v25 verifier uses referencing.Registry and offline Resource resolution.

failure_mode: Object registry identity-bearing fields lacked a mutation guard.
correction: Identity-bearing fields are immutable; only one-way retirement metadata may be appended.

failure_mode: Candidate membership roles duplicated final accepted/excluded adjudication results.
correction: Candidate membership contains proposal/hierarchy roles only; final decisions own acceptance and exclusion.

failure_mode: Variant/adjudication revision order and split/unresolved decision structures were not fully normalized.
correction: Revision ordinals, exact decision supersession, split membership, hierarchy, and unresolved persistence are explicit.
